|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">負傷して出撃任務を解かれた元戦闘機パイロット。デス・スターの戦術士官である。優れた戦略家で、帝国軍の宇宙戦闘機の指揮を専門としている。</span>''
|translation='''Title:''' Lieutenant Tanbris.

'''Card text:''' Starship weapons may be deployed at deploy cost −1 on a starship he pilots. A starship he pilots has power +2 but maneuver −1.

'''Lore:''' A former fighter pilot relieved of flight duties after an injury. He is a tactical officer on the Death Star, a skilled strategist who specializes in directing Imperial starfighters.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text applies the maneuver reduction to a starship he pilots. The English printed card applies it to a starfighter he pilots.
